repository_case_discrepancy: README capitalizes DeepInfer, pyproject uses deepinfer. GitHub repository names are case-insensitive but the canonical spelling is UNRESOLVED from an archive with no .git.

revision_evidence.method: The snapshot is a GitHub codeload archive (DeepInfer-main.zip) extracted without .git. It contains no commit id, ref log or gitlink metadata. The commit is therefore recorded as UNRESOLVED rather than invented. The content is pinned by sha256 of the archive plus a deterministic tree digest over sorted 'path\0sha256\0bytes' records, which any holder of the same bytes can recompute offline.
resolution_steps: Obtain upstream history by a method the operator explicitly authorizes (git ls-remote / a fresh clone).
Find the commit whose tree matches tree_digest_sha256 over the SAME file set after excluding the six absent git submodules.
Record that commit in manifests/upstreams.toml revision = '<40-hex>' and keep this digest as the independent check.
If no commit matches, keep UNRESOLVED and do not claim PINNED_UPSTREAM.

license_file.note: Full Apache License 2.0 text; no NOTICE file and no per-file copyright header in the archive root. Two source files carry third-party (vLLM/EleutherAI/HuggingFace) copyright lines.

snapshot_scope: Reference-only intake of the public DeepInfer source archive. No upstream tree is vendored or built. Source bytes are analyzed, not redistributed.

excluded.reason: benchmark/architecture diagram image; not source; see upstream README link rather than retaining a copy
benchmark result image; not source; benchmark figures are not local evidence
benchmark result image; not source; benchmark figures are not local evidence
benchmark result image; not source; benchmark figures are not local evidence

submodule_note: The six git submodule directories are empty in the archive and .gitmodules exists but carries no gitlink revisions. Any claim of a complete, byte-reproducible dependency set is therefore unsupported.
reason: Reference donor for deterministic/batch-invariant sampling, confidence-scheduled MTP verification, structured-output x speculative interaction and async-scheduler invariants, all read and then ported with attribution if they survive local qualification. DeepInfer is not runnable on the RTX 3070 target and is not a candidate runtime.

archive.storage: off-repository. The archive as received is a GitHub codeload .zip; .gitignore covers /vendor/ and /evidence/logs/*.tar.gz but NOT *.zip, so storing it under evidence/logs/ would silently make 2.5 MB of donor bytes publishable. Keep it outside the repository.
archive.publication: not published; identity is the sha256 recorded here
archive.if_retained_in_repo: store as evidence/logs/deepinfer-main-a2f6f0a4.tar.gz (already covered by /evidence/logs/*.tar.gz), and record the repack digest separately from the source .zip digest. Do not add an ignore rule as part of a vendoring change without the same review as the vendoring itself.

blockers: csrc/ is a torch C++ extension: 20 of 33 files include <torch/...> and 23 of 33 use pybind11; there is no independently compilable C++ subset
six dependency packages (deep_gemm, deep_ep, flash_mla, deep_select, ...) are imported from absent submodules; setup.py compiles only csrc/, so the archive cannot be imported as-is
advertised target hardware is NVIDIA SM100 / Ascend 950; reference host is RTX 3070 sm_86
supported model is DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash only; model_type deepseek_v41 is required by the HF config parser

verification.method: sha256sum over every extracted file; tree digest recomputed from the emitted records; no build, no import, no network.
